description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. 

At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. That same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it!

Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. As a Software Engineer on Forge, you'll design, build, test, ship, and run the platform Apple's engineering teams build on, working closely with those teams to find where the infrastructure beneath them gets in the way and fixing it.

Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) is part of IS&T and delivers global-scale platforms and services that keep Apple's operations secure and running. The team manages identity, device security, and anti-abuse platforms — covering everything from manufacturing and repairs to software updates and activations. ETS also oversees supply chain, manufacturing, and partner integration platforms, protecting data on more than 2.5 billion devices worldwide. And when Apple prepares for a global product launch, ETS owns the systems that ramp factory production — managing serial numbers, network credentials, and verified software.

Description
Join Apple's Identity Management Services (IdMS) team as a Software Engineer and be part of building the next generation of innovative, high-scale software applications.
We are looking for a passionate and driven engineer with experience in developing and deploying large-scale, high-demand systems.

Responsibilities
In this role, you'll be involved in the full software development lifecycle—from architecture and design to implementation, testing, and maintenance. You will contribute to developing new product features, enhancing existing functionality, and driving performance and code quality improvements.

As part of the IdMS team, you'll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including business stakeholders, engineering peers, QA teams, product managers, and human interface designers. This is an opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where your contributions directly impact millions of Apple users around the world.

Minimum qualifications
2+ years of hands-on experience in application development.
2+ years in Core Java, JEE, and multi-threaded programming and object-oriented design principles.
1+ years experience in APIs and HTTP(S) and RESTful architectures.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related engineer degree.

Preferred qualifications
Skilled in designing and developing distributed systems and microservices architectures.
Experience building mobile-responsive web applications, with a focus on cross-browser compatibility.
Well-versed in software engineering best practices, including design patterns and enterprise architecture.
Experience in ReactJS, TypeScript, and web development toolchains including Webpack and Jest.
Experience in data-driven web development, with solid knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, and CSS.
Strong understanding of enterprise systems architecture, concurrent programming, and implementation of efficient data structures.
Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design patterns, multithreading/concurrency models, and complexity analysis.
Backend (Java): Strong proficiency in modern Java (Java 17/21+) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data / Hibernate / JPA).
Data Persistence: Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, cockroachDB), SQL optimization, and caching strategies (Redis, Valkey).
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams and a demonstrated sense of ownership and accountability in project delivery.
